categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Fluence Technology PLC primarily operates in three main business segments: lithium battery cathode materials, new electronic product cooling devices, and LED industry chain related businesses. The lithium battery cathode materials segment is the company's key strategic focus, involving R&D, production, and sales of cathode materials and precursors. The cooling devices segment focuses on thermal management solutions for electronic products, including PC cooling and LED lighting cooling components. The LED segment extends to LED lighting fixtures, energy management contracts, and lighting engineering projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in lithium battery recycling and cathode material production, including physical dismantling, wet chemical separation, and precursor synthesis. It has developed advanced manufacturing processes such as compression, fin attachment, diffusion welding, and embedded tooth technology for cooling products. The firm emphasizes automation and flexible production lines, with self-developed key automated equipment. It holds numerous patents and participates in national and industry standard setting, reflecting strong R&D and innovation capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers and end-users in the consumer electronics, digital products, small power applications, new energy vehicles, and LED lighting sectors. The lithium battery cathode materials serve mainly consumer electronics and small power markets currently, with plans to expand into new energy vehicle power battery markets. Cooling products target PC assembly markets, system manufacturers, and LED lighting manufacturers. LED lighting products are widely applied in stadiums, education, landscape, solar, road, and industrial lighting.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales accounting for over 84% of revenue. It also has overseas operations, including a subsidiary in Belarus, and exports products internationally. The company actively pursues overseas market expansion aligned with the Belt and Road initiative. Its subsidiaries and production bases are located in Shenzhen, Yunnan, Zhejiang, and other provinces, covering key industrial regions in China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shenzhen Fluence Technology operates both upstream and midstream in the lithium battery supply chain, including raw material recycling, precursor production, and cathode material manufacturing. It also operates downstream in electronic cooling solutions and LED lighting products, serving as a component supplier and system integrator. The company maintains a vertically integrated approach in lithium battery materials and a diversified role in electronic product thermal management and lighting.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include consolidating the lithium battery cathode material supply chain, expanding upstream resource integration, and enhancing recycling capabilities to build a closed-loop industry ecosystem. It focuses on innovation in high-nickel ternary materials, high-voltage cobalt acid lithium, and advanced cooling technologies for high-power chips. The firm plans to upgrade production lines with automation and digitalization, pursue green and low-carbon development, and strengthen talent development and internal management efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of lithium battery cathode materials, electronic cooling products, and LED lighting fixtures. The company employs a combination of direct sales and distribution channels, with direct sales dominating lithium battery materials and LED components. It also earns income from contract energy management services and lighting engineering projects. The firm recognizes revenue based on product delivery and service completion, with some sales on export terms.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In lithium battery cathode materials, key competitors include GEM Co., Ltd. and Guangdong Bangpu Recycling Technology Co., Ltd. In cooling products, competitors include Qihong Technology and Xunkai International. In LED lighting, competitors include Leyard Optoelectronics and Shenzhen Unilumin Technology. The company is recognized as a leading domestic manufacturer in PC cooling components and a prominent provider of high-power LED lighting cooling solutions, with strong brand presence and technical advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 635 million, a 44.77% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to a significant decline in lithium battery cathode material sales and inventory impairments. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 239 million, reflecting substantial impairment provisions. The company’s total assets stood at about RMB 2.24 billion, with net assets of RMB 989 million, showing a contraction compared to 2022. Despite recent setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and capacity expansion to support future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive industry chain integration in lithium battery materials, combining recycling, precursor, and cathode material production with proprietary technologies and equipment manufacturing. Its cooling products are distinguished by advanced thermal management technologies, automation, and industrial design excellence, recognized by awards such as the German iF Design Award. The firm offers customized, high-quality, and reliable products with strong after-sales service and rapid order response, aiming to meet diverse customer needs and maintain competitive advantages in emerging markets.
